verdict.rationale: TrueLayer is a hosted payments and open-banking API, so the core platform's source is not shown as available. The only source code in evidence is a peripheral client-side signing library on GitHub (truelayer-signing), and its license is not stated. Missing for 10: open-licensed source for the core product, explicit license terms for the published repos, open-sourced SDKs/MCP server evidenced as such.
